stepTitle: Kippa fits three models and makes a residual plot for each. Which residual plot corresponds to the model with the best linear regression fit to the data?
stepBody: [IMAGE NEEDED: three residual plots (residual $$Y-\hat{Y}$$ vs $$\hat{Y}$$, $$line$$ $$at$$ $$0)$$. $$Plot$$ $$A$$: $$spread$$ $$widens$$ $$as$$ $$\hat{Y}$$ increases (heteroskedastic). Plot B: no pattern (uniform band). Plot C: clear curved pattern.]
